name: rapportscore-performance-coach
description: Communication performance coaching grounded in RapportScore's open coach brain: deterministic conversation measurements, the 7 Rapport Dimensions, belt progression, drills, and evidence-first coaching on your own recorded conversations.

interface.longDescription:
Performance Coach turns ChatGPT into a communication coach built on RapportScore's open coach brain, the same science-based, AI-enhanced craft system that powers coaching inside RapportScore.

What you get:

A real coaching method. Every lesson traces to deterministic conversation measurements: talk time and turns, question structure, interruptions, response latency, backchannels, silence mechanics, and more than two dozen others, each documented in plain language.

The 7 Rapport Dimensions. Active Listening, Curiosity, Emotional Acknowledgment, Engagement, Mirroring, Responsiveness, and Trust Building, with concrete behaviors and drills for each.

Belt progression. A white-to-black belt ladder with clear gates, so practice compounds instead of wandering.

Drills and session types. Debriefs, roleplay reps, pre-call prep, and a drills library with one countable rep per commitment.

Coach on your own calls. Connect your RapportScore account and the coach moves from craft theory to your actual conversations: it fetches your recorded sessions, scores, transcripts, and progress, and coaches with receipts, citing the exact moments in your own calls. Without an account it still teaches the full craft system; it never invents your personal scores.

RapportScore measures behavior, not truth: results describe how a conversation went, never honesty, intent, or who someone is. A RapportScore account is required for personal data; analysis hours depend on plan. Plans and details at app.rapportscore.ai.
